results.title: South African Olympic swimmer switches allegiance to the Netherlands
results.content: Tatjana Smith said 'financial and practical challenges' made it difficult to sustain her swimming career in South Africa.

results.title: Israel swears in new parliament as Netanyahu remains caretaker PM
results.content: Gadi Eisenkot, the politician tasked with forming a new Israeli government, pledged on Tuesday to reverse many of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies as the new parliament was sworn in

results.title: South Sudan vote: UN warns political transition must hold beyond polling day
results.content: South Sudan is just six weeks away from its first national vote since independence, but the United Nations is warning that the real test will come after polling day.

results.title: COP31 activists demand better climate finance for Africa
results.content: At COP31 in Antalya, climate activists are pressing world leaders to put climate justice and financing for Africa at the centre of the talks.

results.title: Gold miners expelled by Guinea start leaving assembly site in Mali
results.content: On November 7, Bamako announced that it had taken in around 160,000 people expelled from Guinea since the start of operations against illegal mining

results.title: UN seeks $2 million for Nigerians fleeing insecurity
results.content: The UN's refugee agency (UNHCR) said in a statement that more than 66,000 had fled across the borders by mid-October, three times the number in the same period last year

results.title: Spain: 69 candles lit at Toledo Cathedral for train crash victims
results.content: Spain's King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia attended a state funeral at Toledo Cathedral on Tuesday 10 November for the 69 people killed in a devastating high-speed train collision near Urda on 28 October.

results.title: Argentina: Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass before 650,000 in Córdoba
results.content: Pope Leo XIV celebrated Mass before an estimated 650,000 people in Córdoba, Argentina. The pontiff greeted crowds from his popemobile before urging worshippers to open their hearts and embrace their faith.

results.title: Lewis Hamilton visits Egypt’s Rafah border to highlight humanitarian efforts for war-torn Gaza
results.content: Formula One superstar Lewis Hamilton has visited Egypt's Rafah border crossing, drawing attention to humanitarian efforts supporting war-torn Gaza.

results.title: Cameroonians call for political renewal and change ahead of February 2027 elections.
results.content: Anticipation is building in Cameroon after President Paul Biya called legislative and municipal elections for February 7, 2027.

results.title: Gambia opposition leader Ousainou Darboe enters presidential race
results.content: The race for Gambia's presidency is heating up, as opposition leader Ousainou Darboe officially files his candidacy for the December 5 election.

results.title: Belgium: Prince Harry and Meghan visit EU Parliament for child safety event
results.content: Prince Harry and his wife Meghan visited the European Parliament in Brussels, on Tuesday 10 November, to discuss the dangers children face online. The couple met families affected by online abuse before Harry addressed the gathering.

results.title: DRC: FRN intensifies offensive, putting FARDC under pressure on multiple fronts
results.content: Security is once again deteriorating in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. In South Kivu, clashes between Congolese forces, backed by Wazalendo militia, and FRN fighters, formerly known as AFC/M23, are intensifying across several front lines.

results.title: Lyon exhibition celebrates Mali’s Sogo bò heritage
results.content: In Mali, animals dance, sing and tell stories through Sogo bò, a traditional performance combining masks, puppets, music and dance.

results.title: Inside the Japanese programme using school committees and remedial classes to improve learning in Madagascar
results.content: A programme developed by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) is tackling low literacy and school dropout in Madagascar by giving parents and communities a direct say in how schools are run.

results.title: Rwandan genocide suspect deported from the United States
results.content: A Rwandan man convicted of lying about his role in the 1994 genocide has been deported from the United States to Rwanda.

results.title: Mauritanian anti-slavery activist Biram Dah Abeid resigns from parliament
results.content: Prominent Mauritanian human rights activist and anti-slavery advocate Biram Dah Abeid announced his resignation from parliament Monday citing "widespread corruption" in the west African country, where he is an opposition lawmaker.

results.title: Lagos' Lekki Conservation Centre under threat from urban expansion
results.content: Established by the Nigerian Conservation Foundation in 1990, the 78-hectare reserve remains an important site for biodiversity conservation, environmental education and ecotourism in Lagos.

results.title: Russia, Ukraine and US resume peace talks in Abu Dhabi amid fresh attacks
results.content: Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States opened Tuesday in the United Arab Emirates, as Washington renews its push to end the war that followed Moscow's all-out invasion nearly five years ago

results.title: Senegalese families mourn sons lost in deadly migrant boat disaster
results.content: Grieving families in northeastern Senegal are struggling to come to terms with the loss of loved ones after a migrant boat capsized off the country's coast, killing dozens of people in one of the deadliest such tragedies in recent years.

results.title: Bodies recovered from migrant boat sailing near Greece
results.content: Greek authorities recovered 13 bodies from a boat carrying migrants found sailing south of Greece's island of Crete early Monday

results.title: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for fleeing rebel fighting
results.content: A military court in the Democratic Republic of Congo has sentenced 66 soldiers to death for offences including desertion, mutiny and disobeying orders during fighting with rebels in the country's east, according to local media.

results.title: Up to 50,000 Ethiopians flee to Kenya as clashes escalate
results.content: Ongoing clashes on the Ethiopian side have forced thousands of people to cross into Kenya seeking safety since 22 October. The UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR) is closely monitoring the situation on the Kenya–Ethiopia border in Moyale.

results.title: Senegal: Footage reveals wreckage of deadly migrant boat in which 39 people died
results.content: At least 39 people have died after a migrant boat sank off Senegal's Atlantic coast. Footage shows the shattered vessel washed ashore as rescuers continue searching for victims.

results.title: Cameroon president sets date for twice-delayed elections
results.content: Cameroonian President Paul Biya, the world's oldest head of state, announced on Monday that legislative and local elections will be held on February 7 -- the first ballots since the veteran leader was reelected in contested polls last year

results.title: Peru: Giant statue of Pope Leo XIV unveiled ahead of papal visit
results.content: A giant statue of Pope Leo XIV has been unveiled in Callao, Peru, ahead of his upcoming visit. The monument honours the pontiff's close ties to the country, where he previously served as a missionary and bishop.

results.title: Senegal vows action on smugglers after latest migrant boat tragedy
results.content: The death toll from the sinking of a migrant boat off Senegal rose to 39 on Monday, authorities said -- one of the country's deadliest migration tragedies in recent years

results.title: Turkey: Steel plant explosion kills 17 in Izmir province
results.content: A devastating explosion at the Habaş iron and steelworks in Aliağa, in western Turkey has killed 17 people. Witnesses described an earthquake-like blast, while footage shows flames, thick smoke and distressed relatives outside the factory.

results.title: Poland: Tusk and Nawrocki honour six victims of Kraków shooting
results.content: Poland's President and Prime Minister set aside their political differences to honour the six victims of a deadly shooting in Kraków. The two leaders laid candles and knelt together at a vigil in the historic city centre.

results.title: Turkey: Delegates arrive in Antalya as COP31 climate talks begin
results.content: The United Nations COP31 climate summit has opened in Antalya after a year marked by deadly heatwaves and devastating floods. Delegates face fresh challenges as the war in Iran disrupts global energy supplies.
